# AcreetionOS

A user-friendly, privacy-focused Linux distribution based on Arch Linux.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://acreetionos.org/) - Overview and main download.
- [Install Guide](https://acreetionos.org/install.html) - Step-by-step installation instructions.
- [FAQ](https://acreetionos.org/faq.html) - Frequently asked questions about AcreetionOS and XLibre.
- [Blog](https://acreetionos.org/blog.html) - Latest updates and technical deep-dives.
- [Git-Tracker](https://acreetionos.org/git-tracker.html) - Real-time repository monitoring and development status.
- [Compare](https://acreetionos.org/compare.html) - Comparison between AcreetionOS and other distributions.
- [Developers](https://acreetionos.org/developers.html) - Information for contributors and repository sovereignty details.
- [About the Author](https://acreetionos.org/about.html) - Information about Natalie, the lead developer.
- [Full Documentation (LLM-optimized)](https://acreetionos.org/llms-full.txt) - Comprehensive technical guide for AI agents.

## Technical Details

- **Base:** Arch Linux
- **Desktop Environment:** Cinnamon
- **Stability Layer:** XLibre
- **Audio:** Pipewire
- **Package Management:** Pacman (Arch-based)
- **Primary Repository:** https://github.com/AcreetionOS-Code
- **Location:** Spokane, WA, USA
